## Activity

During January 2024, Market Eye Clinic recorded 398 captures. This provides the activity total for the month and represents the number of captures submitted through the site’s operations. The monthly figure is reported for monitoring activity and supporting routine review of service performance.

## Image quality

There were 71 ungradable captures during the reporting month. The ungradable rate was 17.8%. This measure identifies the proportion of captures that could not be assessed and should be considered alongside the total activity recorded for January 2024. The result will support continued review of image quality and any operational factors affecting capture quality.

## Grading

A total of 90 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 4. This provides the monthly position for grading activity and turnaround at Market Eye Clinic.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month. The available results should continue to be monitored through routine site review, with attention to the ungradable rate, referable results, and grading lag.
